Tourney odds

Each season plays the regular season (actual finals kept), every conference tournament by Conf Rank, picks the auto bids and 76-team field by Rank, seeds it with the Bracket tab's region, city and conference rules, then plays the four play-in rounds and the bracket. R64 counts play-in winners.

Model lines use the current ratings (rounded to 0.5, moneylines with your vig). Vegas lines come from the sportsbook ESPN shows when you load from ESPN. Edge is how many points the model likes one side over the Vegas spread. Finals show who covered the Vegas line, or the model line if there's no Vegas line. GQI (game quality index, 0-10) rates how good and how close a game should be: team quality (the geometric mean of both teams' rating percentiles, so both need to be good, with extra weight toward elite teams) times competitiveness (how close the win probability is to 50/50). Every game of the season is ranked on that and spread evenly from 0 to 10, so the best game of the year is a 10, a typical game is about 5, and each point holds 10% of games. 70+ is a marquee game, 50+ is worth watching.

Rankings board

Advanced: tempo is possessions per 40 minutes; efficiencies are points per 100 possessions (Adj = vs an average D1 team). Four factors and shooting are raw season totals from ESPN box scores. Luck is wins above what the current ratings expected; volatility is the SD of margins around the model line; over/under is the average actual total minus the model total.

Proj columns are averages over the simulated seasons and include conference tournament games.

Scores

Import scores and dates

One click (recommended). Pulls every D1 game from ESPN day by day: dates, tip times and all finals so far. Run Full season once, then Update recent each day.

Or paste from ESPN. Pick a date, open the day or week link, press Ctrl+A then Ctrl+C on that page, and paste it here. Finished games save as finals, and every game gets its date for the Schedule tab.

Open ESPN dayOpen ESPN week

Also accepted: Massey score-file text (date, @home team, score, team, score, O1 for overtime), or simple lines like Visitor, 72, Home, 65, OT.

Settings

Changes apply to the ratings and lines right away. Click Refresh to update the odds. Settings are remembered in this browser.

Simulation

10,000 is the default. More seasons means steadier odds and a longer run.

Ratings

League HFA is solved from home results each run and kept between the min and max. Team HFA adds each team's own home edge (capped at ±1.2). Shooting luck: 0 uses actual scores, 1 replaces made 3s and free throws with the expected makes from the attempts (shooter's shrunk 3P%/FT% plus part of the defense's 3P% allowed); needs box scores.

Largest margin the rating fit counts. Lower softens blowouts.

Points and lines

Defaults are tuned on a walk-forward backtest of the 2025-26 season (5,724 D1 games): last season's scoring is regressed halfway to average, worth 4 games, and game totals are pulled 10% toward the league average.

Higher SD spreads outcomes wider, so underdogs win more often.

RPI

RPI mix. Weights are scaled to add up to 1.

Adj W % weights. A home loss counts at the road-win weight and a road loss at the home-win weight, as in CQ/CR.

Selection and seeding

Rank weights (normalized to 100%)

Rank = each ranking (SOR, margin test, RPI, Power Rating) times its weight. SOR = wins minus what the #25 team would expect against the same games; margin test = points per game better than the #25 team would do (each loss a 4-point penalty).

Display

How much game quality counts against closeness. 1 = only team quality, 0 = only how close the game is.
